summary: Reduced flow rate at Prestwick radar due to a single air traffic controller, with delays possible for aircraft using Prestwick as an alternate.
text:
PRESTWICK RADAR OPR REDUCED FLOW RATE DUE ATC SINGLE CONTROLLER.
ACFT WISHING TO USE PRESTWICK AS AN ALTN MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYS. ALL 
ACFT INBD TO PRESTWICK ARE TO MONITOR 121.5 AS MANDATED
